bio: Having spent a long period of time gaining experience abroad, the enthusiastic couple at the helm of this restaurant have returned to Italy where they delight their guests with imaginative and creative cuisine that focuses on top-quality ingredients and beautiful presentation. They serve three tasting menus, with the additional option of choosing courses à la carte style. Special mention should be made of the warm welcome, excellent service and skilful wine selection, all of which make the dining experience here even more enjoyable....
